Name: Last Joy
Description:
You conjure a large wooden stake that pierces a target creature, potentially their corpse, into a bonfire. Choose a target within reach: That target must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or be impaled, taking 4d6 piercing damage, otherwise suffering none on a success.

If this spell causes its target to go below 1 hit point, the target starts blazing violently, causing every creature within 30-feet of the bonfire to suffer 4d4 psychic damage if they were friendly to the target or recover hit points equal to half the value rolled, as the flames push them on.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for every two slot levels above 2nd and the value rolled on the creation of a bonfire increases by 1d4 as well.
